send_mail.body:
Dear Daniel and Sven,

A friendly reminder that my three fellowship letters are due Tuesday, December 1, 2026 at 5:00 pm ET:

Kestrel Postdoctoral Fellowship: https://kestrel-fellowship.example.org/letters/KF27-0412
Northfield Foundation Fellowship: https://northfield-foundation.example.org/recommend/NF27-1187
Vireo Fellowship: https://vireo-fellowship.example.org/letters/VF27-5531

Thank you both!
Ana
